integrity: The local factor is obtained by direct differentiation of the source-defined multiplicative gradient, sigmoid gate, signed logarithm, and update map. Global pure-branch divergence follows from monotonicity and the exact large-parameter limit of the multiplicative gradient. Computation is used only as supporting verification.
scientific_limitations: The exact local frontier is proved for the one-dimensional positive quadratic-with-offset family and the core HMGD update. The neutral boundary cases, optional momentum or manifold extensions, and general nonlinear objectives are not classified. The pure multiplicative divergence statement starts strictly above a positive minimizer.
title: Pure multiplicative ascent and the exact local stability frontier of HMGD
